forms.name: Online Consumer Complaint Form
forms.description: Submit a consumer complaint against a business through the CA AG's online portal.

attachments_order.description: Copy of the demand letter sent to landlord

steps.instruction: Go to the CA Attorney General's consumer complaint page.
Fill in the online form with your information, the landlord/management company information, and a description of the deposit dispute.
Upload supporting documents: your demand letter, lease, itemization, and any correspondence.
Submit the complaint. You'll receive a confirmation number.
The AG's office reviews complaints and may take action if a pattern of violations is identified. Individual resolution is not guaranteed but the complaint creates a record.
steps.note: The AG does not typically resolve individual disputes but uses complaints to identify systemic violations.
